definition: Rolling evidence log for material, source-linked observations. Entries may confirm, contradict, or simply sharpen the measurement plan; they do not constitute a score or a recommendation.

entries.title: First Cloudflare AI-bot observation recorded
entries.summary: The dashboard now holds a 30-day AI-bot traffic index of 72.4, down 10.7% versus the prior 30-day control window returned in the same query.
entries.thesisRead: One normalized network point improves observability but establishes neither a trend nor a conclusion about total agentic activity.

entries.title: Akamai reports a governance gap around nonhuman AI activity
entries.summary: Akamai's September State of the Internet report said more than 40% of enterprise users had installed AI browser extensions and 25% had altered permissions in the prior 12 months; it also highlighted ungoverned nonhuman identities and MCP exposure.
entries.thesisRead: This is relevant demand evidence for controls around agentic deployment, not a company revenue metric. It should be treated as a company-published market observation and verified against adoption and monetization disclosures over time.
entries.sourceLabel: Akamai State of the Internet report release

entries.title: Akamai separates agentic web traffic from generic AI bots
entries.summary: Akamai's Bot Directory now separates AI training crawlers, AI search crawlers, and AI fetchers and agents, with the latter category covering requests made on a user's behalf or during autonomous tasks.
entries.thesisRead: The change improves measurement and product fit for agentic controls. It does not disclose customer adoption, pricing, attach rate, ARR, or incremental margin.

entries.title: Elastic's cloud mix carried a visible hosting-cost trade-off
entries.summary: Elastic's Q1 10-Q showed Elastic Cloud revenue up 20% and 49% of total revenue, while total gross margin fell to 74% from 77% and subscription gross margin fell to 80% from 82% as cloud hosting costs rose faster than subscription revenue.
entries.thesisRead: Consumption exposure is relevant to the thesis, but value capture requires margin and cash-flow discipline. Elastic Cloud growth must not be assumed to be agent-driven or automatically high-margin.

entries.title: Elastic reported cloud and contracted growth alongside agentic workflows
entries.summary: Elastic reported Q1 revenue growth of 15%, sales-led subscription growth of 18%, cRPO growth of 21%, and agentic Kubernetes investigations plus MCP-based observability skills.
entries.thesisRead: This establishes a plausible route from agentic activity to Elastic's paid cloud and subscription products. It does not disclose agent-specific revenue, usage, pricing, or retention.

entries.title: F5 added MCP governance to its AI Gateway control plane
entries.summary: F5's AI Gateway update combined model access and cost optimization, MCP agent-to-tool controls, and AI Guardrails within its AI Security Platform.
entries.thesisRead: The product has a credible enforcement-point role in agentic infrastructure. F5 did not disclose commercial availability, customer adoption, attach rates, revenue, or margin for this offering.

entries.title: Dynatrace proposed an AI-observability acquisition with a stated margin trade-off
entries.summary: Dynatrace announced a proposed $915 million Arize acquisition and said it expected roughly 200 basis points of FY2027 ARR-growth accretion alongside about 175 basis points of non-GAAP operating-margin dilution.
entries.thesisRead: The proposal strengthens AI-observability relevance, but it remains forward-looking and subject to closing and integration. The expected margin dilution makes execution, not narrative, the key test.

entries.title: Akamai flags a cost curve behind cloud and AI capacity growth
entries.summary: Akamai's Q2 10-Q says that competition for server, memory, co-location, and data-center capacity is increasing future capital expenditure, depreciation, and other platform costs as it expands cloud infrastructure and AI capabilities.
entries.thesisRead: CIS growth alone is insufficient. The shareholder-capture case needs evidence that contract conversion, gross margin, and cash generation overcome the capacity investment curve.

entries.title: F5's filing retains cyber-incident exposure as a separate risk
entries.summary: F5's Q3 10-Q said that customers or third parties may assert claims and that it has received a small number of government inquiries related to its previously disclosed 2025 cyber incident.
entries.thesisRead: This is not a Wave-2 demand signal, but it is material to the company-capture assessment and should be tracked separately from AI Gateway product potential.

entries.title: Akamai disclosed sharply growing cloud-infrastructure demand
entries.summary: Akamai reported CIS revenue up 39% year over year and cited more than $2.8 billion of year-to-date CIS commitments, including a greater-than-$600 million four-year robotics-related contract.
entries.thesisRead: This is company-specific evidence that a relevant infrastructure supplier can win large AI/robotics-adjacent commitments; it is not an agent-specific revenue disclosure.

entries.title: Akamai's delivery mix and margins did not uniformly improve
entries.summary: In the same quarter, Delivery and other cloud applications revenue declined 6% year over year and non-GAAP operating margin fell five percentage points to 25%.
entries.thesisRead: A growing AI-adjacent category does not automatically produce broad delivery growth or operating leverage. Keep macro demand and shareholder capture separate.

entries.title: Dynatrace reported rapidly rising logs consumption and agent capabilities
entries.summary: Dynatrace reported Q1 ARR growth of 17%, revenue growth of 16%, and annualized logs consumption of $200 million growing well over 100% year over year. It also disclosed Autonomous SRE, Cloud SRE, and Agent Building capabilities.
entries.thesisRead: The consumption and product signals are relevant, but they do not establish agent-specific revenue, usage, pricing, or retention.

entries.title: Dynatrace's subscription margin reflected higher cloud-hosting costs
entries.summary: Dynatrace's Q1 10-Q showed subscription gross margin falling to 85% from 86%; the company attributed the decline primarily to higher cloud-hosting costs supporting SaaS usage and feature adoption.
entries.thesisRead: The recurring test is ARR and revenue conversion after hosting costs. More telemetry consumption is not automatically operating leverage.

entries.title: F5 reported product growth but no AI Gateway monetization metric
entries.summary: F5 reported 19% product-revenue growth and 11% total-revenue growth, while its agentic-ready gateway remains a product-relevance disclosure rather than a separately reported revenue stream.
entries.thesisRead: The relevant control-plane product exists, but the investment question remains whether it changes growth, mix, retention, or margin in disclosed results.

entries.title: Akamai reported a large commerce AI-bot share
entries.summary: Akamai said that, as of December 2025, 47.9% of commerce traffic across its global network consisted of AI bots.
entries.thesisRead: This strengthens the case that nonhuman web activity is material in a key transaction-intensive vertical, while remaining a security/network sample that includes malicious, scraping, and crawler traffic—not a measure of productive agent use.
entries.sourceLabel: Akamai State of the Internet: Securing the Agentic Storefront

entries.title: Anthropic reports a shift toward long-running agentic tasks
entries.summary: Anthropic said that growth in Claude Code and Cowork means its sessions increasingly consist of long-running agentic tasks, and it expanded its telemetry to study the evolving pattern.
entries.thesisRead: This is supporting product-usage evidence for deeper workflows, not proof of enterprise-wide deployment, revenue capture, or an aggregate automation rate.
